اسبكروا (form IVq)
# اِسْبَكَرُّوا (isbakarrū) /is.ba.kar.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
# اِسْبَكِرُّوا (isbakirrū) /is.ba.kir.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
